query:
SELECT
                bp.id,
                bp.board_id,
                bp.icon,
                bp.cover_id,
                get_i18n_all_string_translations(bp.title) AS title,
                CASE WHEN $1 THEN get_i18n_all_string_translations(bp.content) END AS content,
                CASE WHEN $2 THEN get_i18n_all_string_translations(bp.content_html) END AS content_html,
                CASE WHEN $3 THEN get_i18n_all_string_translations(bp.content_plain) END AS content_plain,
                get_i18n_all_string_translations(bp.location) AS location,
                bp.event_from,
                bp.event_to,
                bp.created_at,
                bp.visibility AS "visibility: PostVisibility",
                ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'status', m.status, 'mime', m.mime, 'size_bytes', m.size_bytes,
                    'content', jsonb_build_object('type', m.type, 'width', m.width, 'height', m.height, 'variants', m.variants, 'filename', m.filename))
                FROM media m WHERE m.post_id = bp.id ORDER BY m.position) AS "media!: Vec<PostMediaModel>",
                -- same rule as update_post
                COALESCE($4::uuid IS NOT NULL AND (
                    account_board_perm_exists($4, bp.board_id, 'moderate'::board_perm)
                    OR (bp.account_id = $4 AND account_board_perm_exists($4, bp.board_id, 'post'::board_perm))
                ), false) AS "can_edit!"
            FROM board_posts bp
            WHERE bp.id = $5
                -- visibility
                AND (bp.visibility = 'public'
                    OR ($4::uuid IS NOT NULL AND (bp.visibility = 'logged_in' OR account_board_perm_exists($4, bp.board_id, 'view'::board_perm))))
